messages:
maya: Heads up — privacy team just flagged a handful of DSAR deletion requests that missed SLA window. Looks like our keystore -> KMS pipeline started dead-lettering entries around 20:13 UTC due to KMS throttling. Can eng-security + infra triage? :sos:
oliver: On it. Do we have the error pattern? last time it was `RateExceededException` vs `InternalError` which changes the retry strategy.
samir: Pulling logs now. Saw spikes in `kms-requests` and queue backpressure around 20:12. Example from worker log: ```2026-02-18T20:12:43Z ERROR keystore/sync.go:214 failed to encrypt blob: kms: Rate exceeded (status=429) trace=abc123```
jordan: For privacy: if any deletion operations landed in DLQ we need an auditable evidence trail before attempting retry or re-enqueue. Don't reprocess without capturing proofs.
maya: Understood. Two immediate asks: 1) prevent more DSARs from being marked completed incorrectly, 2) get a safe replay plan that preserves proof-of-deletion metadata.
oliver: Mitigation idea: flip pipeline to `reject-on-kms-fail` -> mark record as "pending-erasure-manual-review" instead of auto-complete. That prevents SLA false-negatives and stops replays touching user data until privacy signs off. I can push a config change to feature-flag this.
samir: Can do quick flag. Patch snippet: ```PATCH /v1/keystore/pipeline/config { "on_kms_error": "mark_manual" }``` Will roll out to staging, then prod in 2m.
maya: Please include a small metric around count of records moved to manual so we can measure impact.
jordan: Also: add retention-evidence blob copy to a legal bucket (read-only) when a delete is attempted — capture request id, timestamp, keystore id, and current KMS error. That way we have the artifact even if the delete fails.
legal: +1 from legal — we need immutability on that evidence store for at least 90 days. Also don't include sensitive plaintext in the evidence copy; only identifiers and hashes.
deploy-bot: deploy started for feature-flag `keystore-mark-manual` on canary nodes (node=keystore-canary-3) 
oliver: Canary looks green for basic flows. However one worker still hit 429s when replayed against KMS. We should add exponential backoff + random jitter and a longer retry window for idempotent operations, but cap retries to avoid masking failures. Suggest policy: 5 attempts, base backoff 200ms -> max 10s.
samir: Implemented retryer with jitter. Also added a deadletter forwarding worker that copies DLQ item metadata to `privacy-evidence` bucket and tags with `dsar_id` before moving to `manual-queue`. Command to inspect DLQ entries: ```gcloud pubsub subscriptions seek dsar-keystore-dlq --time 2026-02-18T20:00:00Z```
maya: Thanks. jordan/legal — can you confirm that the evidence scheme covers audit needs? We want to be able to show: attempted deletion timestamp, worker id, KMS error code, and a hash of the encrypted object.
jordan: That is fine as long as hashes are collision-resistant (sha256) and we attach a signed assertion (service account signature) for the record. We'll need a short runbook step: sign the evidence blob with the `priv-evidence` service account.
legal: Confirmed. Make sure RBAC change to allow `keystore-worker` to put objects in `privacy-evidence` is scoped and limited to that service account. No broad permissions.
oliver: I'll open a minimal change PR to IAM: grant `roles/storage.objectCreator` to `serviceAccount:keystore-worker@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com` on the single evidence bucket. Then we rotate creds for the worker after.
samir: Putting note here: we also want to reduce ephemeral key TTL to reduce window for replayable objects — propose TTL from 24h -> 2h for deletions pipeline only. That reduces risk if any replays happen.
maya: Good call. Also add a dashboard alert: `dsar.deadletter.rate > 0 for 5m` trigerring PagerDuty to privacy-oncall and eng-security.
deploy-bot: canary promotion complete for `keystore-mark-manual`; rollout to prod in 3m.
maya: OK folks — action items: oliver (IAM PR + config flag), samir (DLQ forwarder, retryer, TTL change), jordan/legal (evidence schema signoff + runbook snippet). I'll draft an incident ticket and set a 24h postmortem.
oliver: PR #4892 created with minimal IAM change, attaching policy and justification.
samir: DLQ forwarder merged and deployed. Replay-run script: ```./scripts/replay-dlq --source dsar-keystore-dlq --target manual-queue --dry-run``` Use `--apply` to actually move.
jordan: Evidence schema approved; adding step to subject-request runbook to verify the `privacy-evidence` bucket contains signed artifacts before closure.
legal: We'll request audit retention exception review if this becomes recurring. For now, keep the evidence retention to 90 days and revisit after postmortem.
maya: Thanks team. I'll update privacy with ETA for impacted DSARs and keep this thread for any follow-ups. :white_check_mark:
